steps.en: Add the library, or install the CLI globally
steps.zh: 装库，或全局安装命令行
steps.code: npm install marked · npm install -g marked

steps.en: Import it and convert Markdown in one call
steps.zh: 导入后一次调用完成转换
steps.code: const html = marked.parse('# Marked in Node.js')

steps.en: Its lexer tokenizes the source and the renderer emits the HTML string, GFM defaults included
steps.zh: lexer 切 token，renderer 出 HTML，默认带 GFM

steps.en: Sanitize the output yourself before injecting untrusted input into the DOM
steps.zh: 不可信输入先自己净化再注入 DOM

value.en: Markdown to HTML in one dependency-free call, identical in browser and Node; sanitizing stays explicitly yours
value.zh: 一次零依赖调用把 Markdown 变 HTML，浏览器与 Node 一致；净化归你管
